Container.Name: Filmhound

Branch.TagDescription: Built every night from the newest code: new features first, occasional bugs

Container.Overview:
Movie and TV recommendations built from your own Plex library, ratings and watch history. A list to browse, never automatic downloads.
Every pick says why ("Because you watched Out of the Past"). Endless scrolling, genre and decade filters, rows by theme, where-to-stream, trailers, actor pages, a watchlist, missing films from collections and directors you own, and upcoming releases from people you like. Send titles to Radarr or Sonarr with your quality profile, or request them through Seerr. Imports Letterboxd and Trakt history and can copy those ratings to Plex.
Needs a Plex server and a free TMDB API key. A short walkthrough on the first start sets everything up.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: recommendations discovery plex tmdb radarr sonarr seerr overseerr jellyseerr letterboxd trakt movies tv
Container.Requires: A Plex Media Server and a free TMDB API key (themoviedb.org/settings/api). Seerr, Radarr, Sonarr, Letterboxd and Trakt are optional.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Used for the nightly sync time.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the app runs as. 99 is Unraid's nobody.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the app runs as. 100 is Unraid's users.

Config.Name: HTTPS certificate
Config.Description: Optional. Serve HTTPS directly: path inside the container to a certificate, e.g. /data/certs/cert.pem (put it in your Data folder). Leave empty for plain HTTP or when a reverse proxy handles HTTPS. If you set this, change the WebUI link to https.

Config.Name: HTTPS key
Config.Description: Optional. The certificate's private key, e.g. /data/certs/key.pem.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Optional. Addresses allowed to tell the app a request came in over HTTPS (your reverse proxy). Empty trusts private networks (192.168.x, 10.x, 172.16-31.x and Tailscale), which suits a proxy on your own server.
